banner: DESIGN PREVIEW — sample placeholders only. These are not cost-of-living figures.

dimensions.note: Income is optional and stays in the browser. Tenure null means the figure applies to both rent and own. both is the explicit form of that.

nationalTables.note: The reader column is looked up here at runtime. Fallback is ZIP, then county (largest Census ZCTA-to-county share), then metro, then state, then Not available. This preview has no rows, so the level used is Not available. A national-only series, if one is added later, is labelled U.S. average and is not a silent fallback.

areas.name: Manatee County
areas.note: Gulf Coast column. North Port-Bradenton-Sarasota metro.

areas.name: Hillsborough County
areas.note: Gulf Coast column. Tampa-St. Petersburg-Clearwater metro.

areas.name: Pinellas County
areas.note: Gulf Coast column. Tampa-St. Petersburg-Clearwater metro.

areas.name: Sarasota County
areas.note: Gulf Coast column. Venice and North Port are also their own columns.

areas.name: Venice
areas.note: Place inside Sarasota County. Place FIPS 1273900 is the Census code. ZIP list is not loaded in this preview.

areas.name: North Port
areas.note: Place inside Sarasota County, shown beside Venice. Place FIPS 1249675 is the Census code. ZIP list is not loaded in this preview.

categories.label: Price index
categories.definition: Headline index for the area compared with the reader’s area, plus an equivalent income. Never added to the monthly dollar sum.

categories.label: Monthly sum
categories.definition: Sum of the non-overlapping monthly rows only. Excludes the price index and state income tax. Not calculated in this preview.

categories.label: Housing
categories.definition: Renters: gross rent, utilities included except telephone. Buyers: principal and interest at a median price, taxes and insurance excluded.

categories.label: Utilities
categories.definition: One row. Expands to electricity, water and sewer, and internet. Hidden for renters because gross rent already includes utilities. Internet is not estimated.

categories.label: Home insurance
categories.definition: Home policy, separate from flood. The monthly sum will use a monthly equivalent once a source exists.

categories.label: Flood insurance
categories.definition: Not estimated. It depends on the address, not the county.

categories.label: Property tax
categories.definition: Owners only. Florida buyer cells are an example at the median price, not a calculated bill.

categories.label: Groceries
categories.definition: Scales with household size once a source is chosen.

categories.label: Transportation
categories.definition: Day-to-day transportation, not the one-time move. Scales with adults or vehicles once a source is chosen.

categories.label: Healthcare
categories.definition: Scales per person once a source is chosen.

categories.label: State income tax
categories.definition: Below the monthly sum, not inside it. Florida has no state income tax. The reader’s tax needs income, which stays in the browser.

signOff: Dexter sources a figure: value, unit, geography used, source, URL, as-of, retrieved, and license. The URL is checked. Unverified figures do not ship.

Franklin ships it in a pull request that changes data and the check. The check then requires a number, an https URL, a date-formatted as-of, a known geography level, and the same source and vintage across the row.
Guy approves before merge. The status stays DESIGN_PREVIEW until that approval.
